title: Werwulf
overview: A harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

title: Club Kid
overview: A hard-partying New York City club promoter sees his whirlwind lifestyle upended by the arrival of the 10-year-old son he never knew he had.

title: Ink
overview: A group of misfits and visionaries had an idea for a new kind of news - one that would give the people what they want, and would change the face of the world we live in today.

title: Witch on the Holy Night
overview: Near the end of the Showa era in the late 1980s, in Misaki town, an old mansion is rumored to be the home of a witch. After moving into the mansion, Aoko Aozaki begins to learn sorcery from a young mage, Alice Kuonji, the rumored witch of the mansion. The Aozaki family oversees the land on which Misaki is built and the heir (Aoko) is tasked with protecting it. Mysterious intruders have been disrupting the bounded field in Misaki, leading Alice and Aoko to investigate. A mannequin or puppet attacks them and is incinerated. As this happens, both of them spot someone running away, a civilian who must not get away having seen magic alive. Unexpectedly, a young boy named Soujuurou Shizuki is drawn to the mansion and comes to reside with them as well.

title: Bygd på kjærlighet
overview: "Bygd på kjærlighet" is based on the real events that led to the birth of Pizza Grandiosa. The film takes us back to the 80s, where a group of Westerners refuse to comply, and instead decide to stand together and take up the fight against the superior power in Oslo. With love, rage, creative inventions and a good dose of madness, they lay the foundation for what turned out to be one of Norway's most famous brands.  "Bygd på kjærlighet" is a humorous and heartwarming story about a group of people who can argue about most things, but stand together when it really matters.
